Open `index.html` to try it. **Tokens and layout** - The project had no design tokens. Because this is a single component, I used the skill's default token names (`--color-surface-*`, `--color-text-*`, `--color-border-*`, `--glass-bg`, `--r-*`, `--z-sticky` through `--z-toast`).
